annotation.title_clean: A guide to using artificial intelligence in the public sector
annotation.title_en: A guide to using artificial intelligence in the public sector
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Government Digital Service (GDS) and Office for Artificial Intelligence (OAI), UK Government, with The Alan Turing Institute
annotation.summary_en: GOV.UK collection landing page for joint GDS/Office for AI guidance on assessing, planning and using AI in the UK public sector, with Alan Turing Institute guidance on ethics and safety. Includes a ministerial foreword stressing economic opportunity and productivity gains. No robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Joint GDS/OAI guidance on assessing whether AI meets user needs
Guidance on ethical, fair and safe AI implementation, produced with the Alan Turing Institute
Ministerial foreword emphasises AI's economic and productivity benefits
Based on a 2018-2019 review of AI in the public sector
